description: This PHP source file provides API functions for Data Model access in the CCSP framework. It includes functions for retrieving and setting multiple parameters with a common root object, managing object instances (get, add, delete), all facilitating interaction with the underlying data model extension APIs.

methods.name: DmGetStrsWithRootObj
methods.description: Retrieves multiple data model parameter values under a common root object.

methods.name: DmSetStrsWithRootObj
methods.description: Sets multiple data model parameter values under a common root object.

methods.name: DmGetInstanceIds
methods.description: Retrieves instance IDs under a specified object table.

methods.name: DmAddObj
methods.description: Adds a new object instance under a specified object table.

methods.name: DmDelObj
methods.description: Removes an object instance specified by its name.
